caption: The image depicts a neatly folded piece of fabric placed against a plain, light beige background. The grid squares are evenly spaced and the lines are relatively thin. In the center of the visible fabric surface, a set of white embroidered initials or letters, "Y Y," is stitched, each letter composed of a series of small white dots. The overall composition is simple, with the fabric forming the sole object in the drawing and no additional elements or background details present.
